subject: shrimp goby
title: A Nearly Blind Shrimp Survives by Hiring a Fish as Its Eyes

scenes.text: This shrimp can barely see. Predators still almost never catch it.
It's a pistol shrimp, digging a burrow in open sand where hunters patrol all day.
It has terrible eyesight. So it never leaves home alone.
A small fish, a shrimp goby, sits at the entrance. The shrimp keeps one antenna on it.
When the goby spots danger, it flicks its fins, and the shrimp dives back inside.
The fish gets a home. The shrimp gets eyes. That's why it almost never gets caught.

description:
A pistol shrimp with very poor eyesight shares its burrow with a goby that works as its lookout.
The shrimp digs and cleans the burrow and keeps an antenna touching the fish; when the goby flicks its fins, the shrimp retreats.
Which animal partnership surprises you most?
first_comment: At night the shrimp seals the burrow entrance, and both of them sleep inside. Would you trust a fish with your life?
